front.view: It shows a front view of his face, looking straight at the camera.

right.view: It shows a side profile of his head; his nose points to the RIGHT edge of the image and we see the side of his head with his ear.

left.view: It shows a side profile of his head; his nose points to the LEFT edge of the image and we see the side of his head with his ear.

keep: his face and identity (eyes, nose, brows, ears, skin texture, skin tone, facial proportions, age), expression, head angle, his facial hair (EXACT DESCRIPTION FROM THE SPEC, or clean-shaven), his natural hair color and density, his natural hairline, CLOTHING AND ACCESSORIES, the lighting, camera quality, BACKGROUND
